scope: Source-blind engineering/dev diagnostic on 32 ALREADY-EXPOSED PUBLIC SFI-01 worlds 0..31, not virgin scientific held data; no original FKP17 978500..978531 /978600..978663; no first-use of any private source
hypothesis: Directly written local counterexample microfeedback can identify compositional delayed laws from observed public action outcomes and choose actions that achieve real goals, but should be compared against exact conventional symbolic program search with the identical generic grammar/information/actions.
public_observation: After the action, sanitized six-field public transition: 8 uint4 before, 8 uint4 after, action in [0,7], earned reward (-0.25,0,0.25,1), done, up to 16 sanitized prior transitions; no generator law label/shift or alternate actions
learned_delay: source reward at t is outcome of action t-2; input for credited action includes its publicly visible before-context bit, its predecessor action t-3, predecessor-2 action t-4 (0 when unavailable) and its own action
family_ignorance: No model may import source_audit or enumerate SFI-01's named law-family functions. An openly declared GENERIC compositional program grammar with 4 primitive bit/modular operations, two temporal parent terminals, a zero terminal, an 8-valued literal and linear context gain is allowed; this contains the source families, which prohibits any claim of new operator invention.
arms: MICROFEEDBACK_DIRECT_COUNT: 4096-bit source-blind consistent-rule presence mask; update only on delayed earned evidence, predict by equal eligible-rule vote
EXACT_SYMBOLIC_GENERIC: separate conventional exact consistent-program reference using same public grammar and observations; maximum posterior votes, deterministic tie
CONTEXT_EXACT_TABLE: non-parametric (previous,previous2,context,action) public positive/negative lookup; abstain on unseen with fixed default
WRONG_CREDIT: public reward incorrectly attributed to immediately executed action
ORACLE_UPPER: evaluator-only source private hidden law for headroom, never passed to learner

frozen_metrics.primary: mean 16-step ACTUALLY EARNED on-policy reward across 32 worlds, candidate vs strongest exact generic symbolic
frozen_metrics.secondary: goal-termination worlds, candidate vs exact table, wrong-credit and random; operator-hypothesis count after 24 public exploration; raw learned bytes, wall and action cost
frozen_metrics.negative_family_limit: if generic DSL includes source four families, this cannot be used to claim unfamiliar out-of-grammar discovery even on a PASS
frozen_metrics.scientific_pass_rule: FALSE on public nonblind cohort; candidate vs strongest symbolic tie or defeat => DEV_NO_GO_UNIQUE_SUBSTRATE, not native acceptance
frozen_metrics.stop_rule: Freeze the first full outcomes and no post-result tuning of candidate, grammar, controls, constants or thresholds; preserve null/negative

qualification: Focused tests and Git SHA/type/negative controls first. Full final root regression both OS and G29 before any integration. Research only and no automatic promotion.
